capability_areas.name: Multi-state sales tax
capability_areas.description: Owns filings across twelve states end-to-end. Director steps in only on edge cases.

depth_distinction.builder_definition: Owns the twelve-state filing process from intake to filed return.
depth_distinction.user_definition: Operates the existing process; escalates edge cases to the Director.
depth_distinction.edge_case_guidance: Escalation triggers are new-state additions and sourcing-rule changes only; numerical anomalies are handled in-role.
